title: $25 Starter Plan on Mastra Platform
summary: Starter is now $25 a month and includes one Small dedicated server. The free tier is renamed Free, and dedicated compute comes in three project sizes.
body_markdown:
Today we're introducing a[$25 Starter plan](https://mastra.ai/pricing) on[Mastra platform](https://mastra.ai/ai-agent-deployment) . Starter raises the monthly allowances for compute, data, and observability events, and includes one Small dedicated server. That server's compute is included in the $25. Usage past the included allowances is billed on top.


We're changing how compute is measured, and updating allowances on every plan. A serverless agent stays free to run on every plan, including Free.


Dedicated servers are the path up from serverless. There are three project sizes. Each size includes that server's vCPU and memory for the billing period.


Your browser does not support the video tag.Joel Smith walks through the Mastra platform pricing page: Free, Starter, Team, and Enterprise, then Serverless, Small, Medium, and Large project sizes.


## Updated plans


Allowances are higher on every plan. The free tier is now called Free, and the $25 plan is called Starter.


On Free, you can build, deploy, and test an agent within a billing period. Starter is the upgrade for production traffic: one Small dedicated server, with that server's compute included.


- Unlimited agents


- Unlimited users


- Unlimited deployments


- 100K observability events


- 1 GB egress


- 5 connections


- 15-day trace retention


[Get started](https://projects.mastra.ai/)


- Everything in Free, plus:


- 1 small dedicated project


- Usage alerts


- 250K observability events


- 10 GB egress


- 10 connections


- 60-day trace retention


[Get started](https://projects.mastra.ai/)


- Everything in Starter, plus:


- 2 medium dedicated projects


- SOC 2 report


- 10M observability events


- 100 GB egress


- 50 connections


- 180-day trace retention


[Get started](https://projects.mastra.ai/)


## Vertical scaling


Some agents run business-critical workflows around the clock. Others run on demand and store less data.


A project runs serverless, or on a Small, Medium, or Large server.


### Serverless


Free + usage


- 1 GB memory, 0.5 vCPU
- Memory and vCPU billed as used
- Scales to zero
- 1 environment
- 512 MB storage then $10 / GB per project


### Small


$25


/ month


- 2 GB memory, 1 vCPU
- Memory and vCPU included
- Always on
- 2 environments
- 1 GB storage then $10 / GB per project


### Medium


$100


/ month


- 8 GB memory, 4 vCPU
- Memory and vCPU included
- Always on
- 3 environments
- 10 GB storage then $10 / GB per project


### Large


$200


/ month


- 16 GB memory, 8 vCPU
- Memory and vCPU included
- Always on
- 3 environments
- 100 GB storage then $10 / GB per project


## Connect pricing


[Mastra Connect](https://mastra.ai/docs/mastra-platform/connect) now has a connection allowance on each plan. Egress from those connections counts toward the plan's egress usage.


Free Starter Team Additional


5 connections 10 connections 50 connections $0.50 each


## What's next


Accounts on the current free plan, previously named Starter, continue on Free with the updated usage categories.


Projects with the Server Always-On add-on are migrated to a Medium project size. You can change the size after that.


Team includes two Medium dedicated servers. You can assign a Medium project size to any two projects on the account. If the account already has Server Always-On projects, charges for up to two of them are prorated through the rest of the billing period.


Get started at[projects.mastra.ai](https://projects.mastra.ai/) .
